description.text: A true Texas masterpiece, this extraordinary +/-30-acre estate offers an unmatched blend of timeless elegance and breathtaking natural beauty just a short drive from the city. Completely taken down to the studs and meticulously renovated, the colonial-style residence is filled with abundant natural light, rich brick flooring, and warm architectural accents that create an inviting yet sophisticated ambiance. Majestic live oaks, stately pecans, and fruit trees grace the landscape, while lush open pastures provide the perfect setting for horses or cattle. A healthy pond with a fishing pier invites peaceful afternoons, and enchanting lighted pathways transform the property into a magical retreat after sunset. Complete with a charming guest cottage, spacious shop, multiple barns, and abundant wildlife drawn to thoughtfully placed feeders, every detail has been designed to embrace the finest in country living. Rarely does a property of this caliber, beauty, and convenience become available.
